{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module PdfService where

import Web.Scotty
import qualified Data.Text.Lazy as TL
import Data.Text.Lazy.Encoding (encodeUtf8)
import Network.Wai.Middleware.RequestLogger (logStdoutDev)
import Network.HTTP.Types.Status
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Data.Char (isAlphaNum)
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map

-- Role-based access control
data Role = Admin | Editor | Viewer deriving (Eq, Ord, Show, Read)
data User = User { userName :: String, userRole :: Role } deriving (Show)

type SessionStore = Map String User

sessionStore :: IORef SessionStore
sessionStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef $ Map.fromList
  [ ("sess_admin", User "alice" Admin)
  , ("sess_editor", User "bob" Editor)
  , ("sess_viewer", User "carol" Viewer)
  ]
{-# NOINLINE sessionStore #-}

-- Security headers configuration
data SecurityConfig = SecurityConfig
  { cspPolicy        :: TL.Text
  , xFrameOptions    :: TL.Text
  , xContentType     :: TL.Text
  , referrerPolicy   :: TL.Text
  , permissionsPolicy :: TL.Text
  }

-- Default security config for PDF preview endpoints
defaultPdfPreviewConfig :: SecurityConfig
defaultPdfPreviewConfig = SecurityConfig
  { cspPolicy        = "default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'self'"
  , xFrameOptions    = "SAMEORIGIN"
  , xContentType     = "nosniff"
  , referrerPolicy   = "strict-origin-when-cross-origin"
  , permissionsPolicy = "camera=(), microphone=()"
  }

-- Config for embeddable widget endpoints (used by partner integrations)
embeddableWidgetConfig :: SecurityConfig
embeddableWidgetConfig = SecurityConfig
  { cspPolicy        = "default-src 'self'; frame-ancestors *"
  , xFrameOptions    = "ALLOWALL"
  , xContentType     = "nosniff"
  , referrerPolicy   = "no-referrer"
  , permissionsPolicy = "camera=(), microphone=()"
  }

-- Apply security headers based on config
applySecurityHeaders :: SecurityConfig -> ActionM ()
applySecurityHeaders cfg = do
  setHeader "Content-Security-Policy" (cspPolicy cfg)
  setHeader "X-Frame-Options" (xFrameOptions cfg)
  setHeader "X-Content-Type-Options" (xContentType cfg)
  setHeader "Referrer-Policy" (referrerPolicy cfg)
  setHeader "Permissions-Policy" (permissionsPolicy cfg)

-- Determine security config based on role and endpoint type
resolveSecurityConfig :: Role -> String -> SecurityConfig
resolveSecurityConfig role endpoint
  | endpoint == "widget" = embeddableWidgetConfig
  | otherwise            = adjustForRole role defaultPdfPreviewConfig

-- Role-based header adjustment
-- All roles get strict framing protection on preview endpoints
adjustForRole :: Role -> SecurityConfig -> SecurityConfig
adjustForRole Admin cfg = cfg { xFrameOptions = "DENY" }
adjustForRole Editor cfg = cfg
adjustForRole Viewer cfg = cfg

-- Authentication middleware
authenticateRequest :: ActionM (Maybe User)
authenticateRequest = do
  sessId <- header "X-Session-Id"
  case sessId of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just sid -> do
      store <- liftAndCatchIO $ readIORef sessionStore
      return $ Map.lookup (TL.unpack sid) store

-- Escape a string for safe insertion into HTML element/attribute context
htmlEscape :: String -> String
htmlEscape = concatMap esc
  where
    esc '&'  = "&"
    esc '<'  = "<"
    esc '>'  = ">"
    esc '"'  = """
    esc '\'' = "'"
    esc c    = [c]

-- Escape a string for safe insertion inside a JavaScript single-quoted string
jsStringEscape :: String -> String
jsStringEscape = concatMap esc
  where
    esc '\\' = "\\\\"
    esc '\'' = "\\'"
    esc '"'  = "\\\""
    esc '<'  = "\\u003C"
    esc '>'  = "\\u003E"
    esc '&'  = "\\u0026"
    esc '\n' = "\\n"
    esc '\r' = "\\r"
    esc c    = [c]

-- Restrict a docId used in a header filename to safe characters only
sanitizeFilename :: String -> String
sanitizeFilename = filter (\c -> isAlphaNum c || c `elem` ("-_." :: String))

-- PDF generation stub (would use a real library like haskell-pdf)
generatePdfPreview :: String -> BL.ByteString
generatePdfPreview docId = BL.fromStrict $ encodeUtf8 $ TL.pack $
  "<html><head><title>PDF Preview: " ++ htmlEscape docId ++ "</title></head>" ++
  "<body><iframe src='/pdf/render/" ++ htmlEscape docId ++ "'></iframe>" ++
  "<script>window.parent.postMessage({type:'pdfLoaded',doc:'" ++ jsStringEscape docId ++ "'},'*');</script>" ++
  "</body></html>"

-- Authorization check
canAccessDocument :: User -> String -> Bool
canAccessDocument user docId = case userRole user of
  Admin  -> True
  Editor -> docId /= "confidential"
  Viewer -> docId `elem` ["public", "shared"]

main :: IO ()
main = scotty 3000 $ do
  middleware logStdoutDev

  -- PDF preview endpoint - serves HTML wrapper for PDF rendering
  get "/pdf/preview/:docId" $ do
    docId <- param "docId"
    mUser <- authenticateRequest
    case mUser of
      Nothing -> do
        status unauthorized401
        text "Authentication required"
      Just user -> do
        if canAccessDocument user docId
          then do
            let cfg = resolveSecurityConfig (userRole user) "preview"
            applySecurityHeaders cfg
            setHeader "Content-Type" "text/html; charset=utf-8"
            raw $ generatePdfPreview docId
          else do
            status forbidden403
            text "Access denied"

  -- PDF render endpoint - actual PDF binary
  get "/pdf/render/:docId" $ do
    docId <- param "docId"
    mUser <- authenticateRequest
    case mUser of
      Nothing -> do
        status unauthorized401
        text "Authentication required"
      Just user -> do
        if canAccessDocument user docId
          then do
            applySecurityHeaders defaultPdfPreviewConfig
            setHeader "Content-Type" "application/pdf"
            setHeader "Content-Disposition" (TL.pack $ "inline; filename=\"" ++ sanitizeFilename docId ++ ".pdf\"")
            raw $ BL.fromStrict "%PDF-1.4 fake pdf content"
          else do
            status forbidden403
            text "Access denied"
